_readme: Menu, chai, store and allergen data for the Naan Staap app, collected from naanstaap.co.uk and order.naanstaap.co.uk. Edit prices/items here and restart the API. price null = shown as 'in store only'. is_popular marks the 'Popular right now' picks on the home screen.
price_source: Prices come from the order site (order.naanstaap.co.uk) menu for the 'Naan Staap New Road' (whitechapel) branch, eat-in, on 2026-10-24. The main website shows no prices. Prices may differ per branch/order type. price=null means no matching product was found on the order site.

menu_items.name: Anarkali Daal

menu_items.name: Samosa

menu_items.name: Naan Khatai

menu_items.name: Cinnamon Roll Bite

menu_items.name: Brownie Bite

menu_items.name: Almond Cake
menu_items.description: Soft in texture, divine in taste, our house special almond cake is next to none.

menu_items.name: Chocolate Fudge Cake
menu_items.description: This is super moist, made with chocolate and cocoa powder, and frosted with a perfect chocolate glaze.

menu_items.name: Chocolate Lava Cake
menu_items.description: A perfect Chocolate. A mixture of fresh chocolate, eggs, and sugar.

menu_items.name: Pistachio Dream Cake
menu_items.description: It’s soft, fluffy, light and tastes unbelievable, with silky cream cheese frosting on top.

menu_items.name: Hazelnut & Pistachio Cake

menu_items.name: Gajar Halwa

menu_items.name: Gulab Jamun

menu_items.name: Lahori Suji Halwa

menu_items.name: Smore Icecream

menu_items.name: Anda Paratha Roll

menu_items.name: Chicken Wrap

menu_items.name: Chicken Kebab Wrap

menu_items.name: Bun Kabab

menu_items.name: Chicken Club Sandwich

menu_items.name: Chicken Peri Tikka Sandwich
menu_items.description: This is a sandwich with peri tikka flavoured chicken and crispy salad. .

menu_items.name: Bombay Sandwich

menu_items.name: Chips

menu_items.name: Masala Chips

menu_items.name: Chicken Patties

menu_items.name: Chicken Cheese Bake

menu_items.name: Chicken Dum Bake

menu_items.name: Palak Paneer Bake

menu_items.name: Chicken Peri Tikka Panini

menu_items.name: Creamy Pepper Chicken Panini

menu_items.name: Smoky Chicken Loaded Fries

menu_items.name: Halloumi Loaded Fries

menu_items.name: Karak Chai

menu_items.name: Cinnamon Chai

menu_items.name: Caramel Chai

menu_items.name: Vanilla Chai

menu_items.name: Sugar free Chai

menu_items.name: Chai Latte

menu_items.name: Green Tea

menu_items.name: English Tea

menu_items.name: Coffee

menu_items.name: Lemonade

menu_items.name: Mango Lassi

menu_items.name: English Breakfast

menu_items.name: Desi Breakfast
menu_items.description: Start your day with our wholesome and delicious Breakfast Deal! This satisfying meal includes a portion of flavorful Chaana, sweet and comforting Suji Halwa, your choice of bread, and a perfectly brewed cup of Karak Chai to keep you energized. Whether you're in the mood for something savory or sweet, this breakfast deal has it all—packed with flavor and goodness to kickstart your morning!

menu_items.name: Americano
